alkylation reagent: Carbamidomethyl of cysteine was specified as a fixed modification.
cleavage agent: the proteins in gel were digested by 0.02 μg/μl trypsin.
enrichment method: The SAMP1BocK24 and SAMP1Bock24-MoaE conjugate were purified by immunoprecipitation
instrument: Q Exactive HF hybrid quadrupole-Orbitrap mass spectrometer
A total of 1 μg peptides was injected into an Q Exactive HF hybrid quadrupole-Orbitrap mass spectrometer equipped with an UltiMate 3000 UHPLC (Thermo Scientific).
labeling: The raw data was analyzed by Proteome Discoverer 1.4 with the Mascot search algorithm.
